versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the logics-parsing skill.
- Integrates Alibaba Logics-Parsing tool for converting PDFs/images into structured HTML, supporting complex layouts, formulas, chemical structures, code blocks, flowcharts, sheet music, and more.
- Includes detailed feature and benchmark comparisons of v1 and v2, with v2 recommended for improved performance and broader content support.
- Provides comprehensive installation and usage instructions for both versions, including command-line and Python API examples.
- Lists supported content types, application scenarios, sample outputs, troubleshooting tips, and integration with related tools and workflows.
